units.source_text: 少将便把中将深切恳挚之情详细向浮舟传达。

en.t: The Lesser Captain then conveyed the Lieutenant Captain's deep and earnest feelings to Ukifune in detail.

units.source_text: 又向她转述中将的话：“请视我为兄妹关系的人，互相谈谈人世无常的琐事，亦可聊以慰情。”

en.t: He also repeated the Lieutenant Captain's words to her: "Please regard me as someone like a brother to you; we might speak together of small matters in this uncertain world, and so find some comfort for our hearts."

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“你所谓深切恳挚之情，我听也听不懂，实甚遗憾。”

en.t: Ukifune answered, "These deep and earnest feelings you speak of are something I cannot understand no matter how I listen, which is truly regrettable."

units.source_text: 她对这“我被疏嫌”的诗并不作答。

en.t: She made no reply at all to the poem about being slighted and disliked.

units.source_text: 她想：“我身遭逢意外之忧患，人事早已置之度外。

en.t: She thought, "Since this body of mine has met with such unexpected sorrow, I have long since put worldly affairs out of mind.

units.source_text: 但愿身心皆如朽木，见弃于世，以此长终。”

en.t: I only wish that both body and mind might become like rotten wood, cast aside by the world, and remain so until the end."

units.source_text: 因此多时以来异常郁闷，忧患频仍。

en.t: For this reason she had long been extraordinarily gloomy, with sorrows and troubles coming one after another.

units.source_text: 但自从成遂了出家本意之后，心情也舒畅起来，有时和妹尼僧戏咏诗歌，或者围一局棋，愉悦地度送晨昏。

en.t: But after she had fulfilled her long-held wish to take religious vows, her spirits grew lighter; at times she playfully composed poems with the younger nun, or sat down to a game of go, passing mornings and evenings pleasantly.

units.source_text: 修行也非常用功，《法华经》自不必说，其他佛经也读了不少。

en.t: She was also very diligent in her religious practice; needless to say she read the Lotus Sutra, and she read many other Buddhist scriptures as well.

units.source_text: 不久到了冬天，积雪甚深，行人绝迹之时，这小野草庵的环境实甚寂寥。

en.t: Before long winter arrived; when the snow lay deep and all trace of passersby had vanished, the surroundings of this humble hut at Ono were truly desolate.
